articles.title: Daniel Cormier REACTS to Magomed Ankalaev TKO WIN vs. Bogdan Guskov, Ulberg next? | UFC Abu Dhabi
articles.description: Daniel Cormier IS BACK from octagon side in Abu Dhabi to give his INSTANT REACTION to UFC light heavyweight star Magomed Ankalaev FINISHING Bogdan Guskov in the fifth round of their main event fight in Abu Dhabi. DC breaks down Ankalaev's win, and what it means on the heels of having split two championship fights against Alex "Poatan" Pereira. Cormier talks about the heavyweight division and what the plan should be with Carlos Ulberg still out due to injury. Get DC's take on Magomed "Chanco" Zaynukov's debut, Ramazan Temirov's beautiful first-round KO, Valter Walker's fifth straight submission, and what was arguably the best fight on the card with Rizvan Kuniev getting a TKO finish vs. Tyrell Fortune!
